breaking_changes.description: isURL now uses ':' as protocol delimiter like browsers; rejects malformed URLs previously accepted.
breaking_changes.impact: Tests or code relying on permissive URL acceptance may fail.
breaking_changes.mitigation: Update fixtures to valid URLs or adjust isURL options/custom validation.

breaking_changes.description: isLength accounts for Unicode variation selectors ️/︎.
breaking_changes.impact: Some inputs may now exceed limits and be rejected.
breaking_changes.mitigation: Reassess length limits where emoji/variation selectors are common.

breaking_changes.description: Fixes to inefficient regexes in trim/rtrim and other validators.
breaking_changes.impact: Functional behavior similar, reduced ReDoS risk.

test_errors: grocery-api tests returned multiple 400s due to Joi GUID validation on ids (storeId, item.id) and server listen conflicts; grocery-shared tests passed

error.message: GitHub push protection blocked branch push due to detected secret in .helix/config/settings.json (OpenAI API Key). Remote rejected refs/heads/remediation/validator-13.15.22 (GH013).
error.manual_fix: Remove or rotate the exposed secret and rewrite history to delete it from commits. Options: 1) git filter-repo or BFG to purge .helix/config/settings.json from history; 2) Move secret to env/secret store and add path to .gitignore; 3) After purging, force-push the branch; or, if allowed, use the provided GitHub URL to explicitly allow the secret push (not recommended).
